name: rosetta-determine-sentence-type
code:
use default

let text =
    "hi there, how are you today? I'd like to present to you the washing "
    "machine 9001. You have been nominated to win one of these! Just make "
    "sure you don't break it"

ends_a_sentence(letter: char) -> bool =>
    letter == '!' \/ letter == '?' \/ letter == '.'

kind(ending: char) -> string =>
    case ending
    when '!' then "E"
    when '?' then "Q"
    when '.' then "S"
    else "N"
    esac

sentences(source: string) -> Pipe[string] is
    let start mut = 0

    for at in 0..source.length do
        if ends_a_sentence(source[at]) then
            yield source.substring(start, at - start + 1).trim()

            start = at + 1
        fi
    od

    let rest = source.substring(start).trim()

    if rest.length > 0 then
        yield rest
    fi
si

for sentence in sentences(text) do
    write_line("{kind(sentence[sentence.length - 1])}  {sentence}")
od
